title: Stress Less: 9 Habits from the Bible and Brain Science to Build Resilience and Reduce Anxi
description: We’re living in a stressed-out world. According to a poll from the American Psychological Association more than a quarter of U.S. adults say they’re so stressed they can’t function. But it’s not just adults. Teenagers and children are also experiencing the negative effects of stress. Blending brain science, biblical truth, and best practices, Stress Less provides hope and healing. From his PhD research, pastor Charles Stone presents nine actionable insights for those battling stress or who have friends or family with fear and anxiety. Stone writes about biblical characters who successfully and unsuccessfully navigated stress and shares how he’s responded to the stresses in his life, including a cancer diagnoses, heart issue, pre-diabetes diagnosis, and depression. Stone answers the questions: What is stress? What does stress do to the body and brain? How do we build resistance to stress? He shows how changes in thinking, feeling, sleep, spiritual practices, and relationships can help us thrive through life’s stresses. Readers learn how gratitude and soaking your soul in Jesus can cultivate a life of greater well-being and joy. While we can’t eliminate the stressors of life, we can learn to navigate them with courage and grace. title: The Stress Less Devotional: 100 Days to Embrace Rest and Rejuvenate Your Soul
description: Find the rest you've been craving and reconnect to a healthier, happier you. In a world that says do more, be more, and fill every moment, Scripture offers a different take on our need for rest and restoration. Jesus said, "Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest." The Stress Less Devotional invites you to accept Jesus' offer with this 100-day journey to reconnect with the Lord and rejuvenate your soul. Block out the noise and get back to who you were made to be. Inside you will find: 100 devotions to encourage slow living and biblical rest Bible verses that restore you and point you to who God created you to be Daily prayers to help you quiet your thoughts and direct your attention on what really matters Calming beach photography to still your mind and remind you that God is in control A helpful Scripture index to guide deeper Bible reading It is time to worry less and start living more. title: Stress Less Live More: A 100+ Living Guide to Beating Stress and Thriving (The 100+Living
description: In Stress Less, Live More, Dr. Graham Jenkins offers a powerful, evidence-based guide to beating stress and thriving in today’s fast-paced world. As the sixth book in the popular 100+Living Series, this guide combines Dr. Jenkins’ three decades of experience with the latest scientific research on stress management, mental resilience, and physical well-being. Whether you're a busy professional, a student, or anyone juggling the demands of modern life, this book provides actionable strategies for transforming your relationship with stress. Inside, you'll discover how to build resilience through physical health, mental discipline, and emotional regulation, using simple yet powerful techniques that have helped thousands of patients thrive. From incorporating Chiropractic BioPhysics (CBP) care to mastering mindfulness, sleep, and nutrition, Dr. Jenkins presents a holistic approach that will equip you to face life’s challenges with confidence and ease. Dr. Jenkins’ personal journey with stress is woven throughout the book, offering readers a candid and relatable narrative about the ups and downs of navigating life’s pressures. His practical advice, grounded in science and honed by years of working with families, makes this guide essential reading for anyone looking to not just manage stress, but thrive through it. If you're ready to take control of your stress, improve your well-being, and start living with purpose, Stress Less, Live More is the roadmap you need. Verified Amazon Review "Dr. Jenkins has a gift for translating complex health strategies into simple, actionable steps anyone can follow." title: Stress Less: A Teen's Guide to a Calm Chill Life
cats: Teen & Young Adult Emotions & Feelings Nonfiction eBooks
description: Let’s get real. Stress is part of every teen’s life -- stress of exams, college applications, a big game, difficult teachers, difficult friends, parents who don’t always get you, not to mention the dating and social scenes. Stress like this tends to build over time—week after week—and takes a toll on your mental health. But, great news! Learning stress-busting skills doesn’t take much time at all. Just 20 minutes a day is probably all it takes. The skills in this book are easy to learn and can be practiced anywhere -- on the bus, before bed, or during lunch. Once you see that it helps, you’ll adjust and be ready bust more stress. And then before you realize it—you’ve got it! Written by cognitive-behavioral therapist and stress-busting expert, Michael A. Tompkins, PhD, this book teaches concrete skills for managing stress and anxiety, organized into “stress domains” such as family, friends, dating, school, and tech/media. And because stress doesn’t go away when teens hit adulthood, Stress Less will help readers maintain balance and calm as they deal with the ups and downs of life in the months and years to come.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1"]', '#CardInstanceKYLhOROLiopIO9sNXXqwJg')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K,._tell-amazon-deskto

title: Stress Less: Coping with Political Turmoil on Social Media
description: Stress Less: Coping with Political Turmoil on Social Media Feeling drained by nonstop negative news and heated political debate online? Stress Less offers practical, evidence-based tips and techniques to help you protect your mental well-being, stay informed without becoming overwhelmed, and engage online with intention and resilience. What you'll find inside: Quick, actionable coping strategies to reduce anxiety and emotional reactivity during news surges. Practical routines for curating your feed, setting healthy boundaries, and building digital hygiene that lasts. Techniques from cognitive-behavioral therapy, mindfulness, and emotional regulation tailored for social media contexts. Communication tips for navigating divisive conversations without losing your calm or values. Guided exercises, breathing practices, and short reflection prompts you can use anywhere—before bedtime, during scrolling, or after a difficult post. A roadmap for turning digital overwhelm into purposeful action: from journal prompts to civic engagement that honors your well-being. Who this book is for: Anyone exhausted by the cycle of negative political news. Caregivers, activists, students, and professionals who need practical tools to manage stress online. Readers who want to stay informed without sacrificing mental health. Calm your feed, reclaim your focus, and engage with intention.
